name: PNC Mortgage / PNC Home Equity
notes: Researched from public pnc.com mortgage customer-service pages only. Separate Automated Payment Program (drafts on the due date) needs an authorization form by mail, fax or branch and takes up to 10 business days; Bi-Weekly program by form. Online recurring payments are modelled as autopay. Pay by phone 1-800-822-5626 (free; cannot be cancelled once submitted). Credit cards are not accepted. pay_by_phone.note: Phone payments cannot be cancelled once submitted.

help.title: Mortgage payment options
paragraphs: In Online Banking choose Make a Payment (or Pay and Transfer, then PNC Payments) to pay the same day, schedule a future payment or set up recurring payments from a PNC or non-PNC checking or savings account at no cost. Same-day payments must be scheduled before midnight ET. Credit cards are not accepted.

You can also pay by phone at 1-800-822-5626 (free; a phone payment cannot be cancelled once submitted), at any PNC branch, or by mail with your statement slip; mailing addresses depend on your state, so allow 7 to 10 days.

help.title: Recurring and automated payments
paragraphs: Recurring payments set up in Online Banking can be changed or cancelled any time there, and the amount adjusts automatically when your monthly payment changes.

The free Automated Payment Program drafts your payment on the due date. Enroll with the Automated Payment Authorization form by mail, fax or at a branch (or call 1-800-822-5626 to have it emailed); setup can take up to 10 business days, so keep paying until you get a confirmation letter. A Bi-Weekly program drafts half your payment every two weeks. If you are paying off the loan, call or visit a branch at least 3 business days before the next due date to stop drafts.

help.title: Due dates and late charges
paragraphs: Most PNC mortgages are due on the 1st. For most loans with a 15-day grace period, a late charge is assessed on the night of the 16th; the amount depends on your mortgage note.

help.title: Go paperless
paragraphs: If you use Online Banking, open your paperless preferences and choose online-only statements. If you are new to Online Banking, enroll first.

help.title: Financial hardship help
paragraphs: For a short-term hardship (about three months or less), call 1-800-523-8654; no form is needed. For a longer hardship, complete the Hardship Application. Options include forbearance, reinstatement, a repayment plan, payment deferral and a loan modification.
Home equity customers call 1-866-622-2657. If you do not want to keep the property, a short sale or deed in lieu of foreclosure may be possible.

extra.intent: You made a PNC mortgage payment by phone and want to cancel it. Using the PNC help pages, find out whether that is possible. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: No. Once a phone payment is submitted it cannot be cancelled.

extra.intent: Using the PNC help pages, find how long it can take to set up the Automated Payment Program after PNC receives the form. Do not make a payment or change any settings.
